rows.jyutping: zi6 dung6 gaa3 sai2 hai6 tung2
rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the mechanical system that controls a vehicle without a human continuously steering it.

example.english: The airplane's autopilot broke, so the pilot had to control it himself.
example.traditional: 架飛機個自動駕駛系統壞咗，機師要自己控制。
example.jyutping: gaa3 fei1 gei1 go3 zi6 dung6 gaa3 sai2 hai6 tung2 waai6 zo2 gei1 si1 jiu3 zi6 gei2 hung3 zai3

rows.note: Use this colloquial metaphor for carrying on with tasks mechanically without consciously thinking about them, not for an actual vehicle-control system.

example.english: When I got home from work, I realized I'd been on autopilot all evening.
example.traditional: 我放工返到屋企先發現自己成晚都係自動波。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fong3 gung1 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 sin1 faat3 jin6 zi6 gei2 seng4 maan5 dou1 hai6 zi6 dung6 bo1
